items.text: No one is on screen except: Archie.
Exactly four men are visible: knife man, hoodie man, older man, and Archie. No extra bystanders.
Archie is the only figure not caught in slowed time. He is the one leaving and is clearly separate from the three slowed men.
The knife man is mid-lunge toward the camera with the knife arm extended.
The hoodie man is caught mid-step, with one foot lifted or off the ground.
The older man is standing still by the car, not lunging or stepping.
Archie stands at the mouth of the dark side passage, screen-right midground, half-turned back toward the camera with his head tilted in a 'coming?' gesture.
The broken timePearl lies on the wet tarmac between the men. It shows pearly fragments and a bent gold band.
The carrier bag handle is wrapped round Archie's fist, and the bag hangs from his hand.
Raindrops inside the dome hang as short streaks, and the light smears sideways, like heat haze in cold air.
A rough dome of thickened air surrounds the three men, with a faint cold blue tint inside it only.
The yard, car and side passage match the blank plate. Nothing else in the room has changed, and the image size is unchanged.
The knife, the pearl, all three slowed men and Archie are all fully in frame and not cropped.
There are no runes, sparkles, beams, glow or magic circles anywhere. The dome shows only as haze, streaks and a faint tint.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
